scope.external_review_scope: Only the two committed scheduler files. SDK18 decoded-image retirement review remains separate and unchanged.
scope.other_packaged_change: docs/web-image-assets.md line36 clarifies the already-implemented SDK18 pre-onload-only source reset boundary; it is not part of the Claude19 scheduler review.
scope.reusable_primitive: Async official-player scheduler generation ownership and teardown cancellation, not Game rules or renderer replacement.
scope.unchanged: No active-error message filter, fixed-step/RAF clock policy, catch-up/drop/debt limit, input transaction order, update/accept/draw boundary, completion metric definition, broker/cache/GPU budget, Core/CLI/WASM or Game change.
scope.writer: Offline source/log/JSON extraction only; no new test, build, pack, browser, forced GC, profiler or FPS workload.

trigger.observed: Actual SDK18 worker functional assertions completed, then context.close/pagehide stopped the scheduler and closed the backend. Rejecting an in-flight request with RUNTIME_CLOSED reached an unconditional scheduler catch and emitted a late console error.
trigger.ownership_defect: An obsolete rejection after stop/start could additionally call stop() on the restarted generation. Active current failures still require reporting.
trigger.preservation: The original SDK18 failed teardown evidence is owned by Root/Web and retained separately; this record does not relabel it as a clean pass.

correction.guard: The originating draw captures generation; catch calls stop()+onError only while started && token===generation.
correction.stop: External stop changes started/generation; its pending rejection becomes cancelled obsolete work, without rendering or reporting an active failure.
correction.restart: Restart waits for busy old transaction retirement. Old catch cannot stop the new owner; finally releases busy and schedules its next RAF once.
correction.current_failure: The same RUNTIME_CLOSED Error still stops/reports once if its request belongs to the active current generation. No message-based suppression is used.
correction.pause_reset_visibility: These already change the generation/clock. Old rejection cannot stop the current clock or populate its successful submission/active preparation samples.
correction.finally: Existing preparation cancellation, busy retirement, onWake and scheduling cleanup remain in the same finally path. No extra parallel tick, timer, render or altered RAF timestamp is introduced.

independent_codex_review.mode: Read-only independent source/diff/regression inspection; author is /root/native_performance.
independent_codex_review.disposition: CLEAR: no concrete P1/P2 found in the frozen two-file change.
independent_codex_review.encoding: Committed LF source and CRLF packaged checkout can have different byte hashes. Both identities are recorded; they are not interchangeable hashes.
independent_codex_review.reviewed: Generation ownership rather than message filtering; active same-message failure; stale restart isolation; unchanged finally/clock/no-overlap behavior.
independent_codex_review.execution_limit: Independent reviewer ran no workloads for this review; the actual gates below have separate executors/logs.

new_cases: Pending worker rejection after stop produces no active error, draw, RAF or completed count.
Old rejection after stop/start cannot stop the new owner; active identical RUNTIME_CLOSED then reports once.
Pause invalidates old rejection without stopping current paused redraw.
Clock reset invalidates old rejection and preserves actual fresh RAF timestamp.
Hide/restore invalidates old rejection and does not catch up hidden time.

negative.method: TDD run of the new tests against unchanged old scheduler before the production catch fix; no Game or SDK artifact mutation.

whole_web.skip_scope: Three existing skips; not679 executed assertions.

speculative_limits: Ownership invalidation cancels old work regardless of its error message; a stale transient fault is not reported as an active owner failure.
A never-settling obsolete tick retains busy and blocks restart, as before. No new timeout or parallel update chain is added.
external_claude_review.scope: One60s-bounded tool-free source-review process. No tests/tools/browser/commands were available to the reviewer; this does not establish emitted shutdown or performance acceptance.

package.schema_caveat: Raw pack result retains a legacy sdk15 schema label; actual pinned path/source/runtime identify SDK19.

limits: Node lifecycle tests and source review do not establish the emitted official-player teardown outcome; Root/Core own a strengthened post-close validation separately.
No actual Game FPS, natural GC cadence, native-node reclamation, resource-cycle slope, leak-free or GC-free claim is made.
SDK19 reuses exact verified compiled CLI/WASM10 and originalUI0.6; no blocked SDK11/fused-copy runtime is represented.
SDK18 completed image-retirement Claude review/source/package record is separate; neither its scope nor earlier failed/incomplete evidence is overwritten.
